verdict.rationale: Meta's canonical llama-models repo has a per-family table with a Model Card column for every release from Llama 2 through Llama 4, and the llama.com FAQ points readers to the Llama 4 model cards, so a card exists for the current flagship. The pack does not show what those cards contain, and the llama.com docs surface sits behind an SSO wall for keyless fetches, though the GitHub-hosted cards are public. missing for 10: evidence the Llama 4 card documents capabilities, training approach, evaluation results and intended use; independent or hands-on corroboration of card depth; publicly readable llama.com docs pages.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can read a published model card or system card — capabilities, training approach, evaluation results, and intended use — for the current flagship model

citations.quote: a published model card and use policy for every released weight family; llama.com's FAQ points to "Llama 3.1, Llama 3.2, Llama 3.3, and Llama 4 model cards for more information."
